decisions.reason: The cutting and creasing finisher remains close to the firm's core postpress know-how, so it can keep interpreting customer results and refining the product through its application and service expertise.
The sheet preparation module builds directly on the firm's modular systems and complements the portfolio, so absorptive capacity stays high even without strong standalone evidence.
The B2 multifinisher is a flagship within the firm's core multifinishing competence and fits its move toward automated workflows, making it a clear candidate to retain.
The hybrid saddle stitcher extends the firm's established booklet-making expertise, letting it learn from customer feedback and improve the product effectively.
The folding add-on unit sits close to the core offer and has a documented customer installation running in one pass, giving the firm results it can interpret and build on.
